subject: general
question: What is a distinguishing feature of “Kruti”, launched in 2025 by Ola’s Krutrim?

options.text: It supports voice and text in multiple Indian languages.
It is optimized only for English language interfaces.
It is designed only for navigation services in rural areas.
It works solely with proprietary hardware provided by Ola.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It supports voice and text in multiple Indian languages.**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **“Kruti”**, launched by **Ola’s Krutrim in 2025**, is a cutting-edge AI platform designed to cater to the diverse linguistic needs of India.
 
• The platform is specifically designed to **support voice and text interfaces in multiple Indian languages**, addressing a significant barrier to technology adoption in a linguistically diverse country like India.
 
• It aims to provide an inclusive experience for users from different linguistic backgrounds, enabling greater accessibility and usability for non-English speakers in India.
 
• This multilingual functionality ensures that the platform can cater to users across urban and rural areas, making it highly adaptable to India’s socio-cultural diversity.
